notes.zh: 错误码（main.rs@acbb40e）：1 data 过短 · 2 status 非法 · 3 goal=0 · 4 deadline=0 · 5 创建时 total≠0 · 6 创建时非 Active · 7 NO_SCRIPT · 9 LOAD_DATA · 10 INVALID_FINALIZATION · 11 MODIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED（已定义，未使用）· 12 INVALID_TYPE_ID · 13 DESTRUCTION_NOT_ALLOWED · 14 LOAD_SINCE · 15 INVALID_ARGS · 16 INVALID_PLEDGE_UPDATE · 17 CAPACITY_DECREASED · 18 STATUS_NOT_JUSTIFIED · 19 OVERFLOW · 20 LOAD_CELL · 21 MULTIPLE_CAMPAIGN_CELLS · 22 PLEDGE_UNDERFUNDED · 23 PLEDGE_BELOW_MINIMUM · 24 CREATOR_NOT_PAID · 25 DESTRUCTION_WITH_PLEDGES · 26 PLEDGE_DEADLINE_MISMATCH · 27 DESTRUCTION_OTHER_TYPED_INPUT · 28 CAMPAIGN_LOCK_CHANGED
notes.en: Error codes (main.rs@acbb40e): 1 data too short · 2 bad status · 3 goal=0 · 4 deadline=0 · 5 total≠0 at creation · 6 not Active at creation · 7 NO_SCRIPT · 9 LOAD_DATA · 10 INVALID_FINALIZATION · 11 MODIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED (defined, unused) · 12 INVALID_TYPE_ID · 13 DESTRUCTION_NOT_ALLOWED · 14 LOAD_SINCE · 15 INVALID_ARGS · 16 INVALID_PLEDGE_UPDATE · 17 CAPACITY_DECREASED · 18 STATUS_NOT_JUSTIFIED · 19 OVERFLOW · 20 LOAD_CELL · 21 MULTIPLE_CAMPAIGN_CELLS · 22 PLEDGE_UNDERFUNDED · 23 PLEDGE_BELOW_MINIMUM · 24 CREATOR_NOT_PAID · 25 DESTRUCTION_WITH_PLEDGES · 26 PLEDGE_DEADLINE_MISMATCH · 27 DESTRUCTION_OTHER_TYPED_INPUT · 28 CAMPAIGN_LOCK_CHANGED

notes.zh: 状态转换前先检查 lock 不变（28）与 capacity 不减（17）；数据解析错误（1 / 2）先于二者。输出为 Active 的交易一律走认捐路径，因此 1 → 2 的 check_status_justified 中以 Active 为目标的分支（同为 10）不可达
notes.en: Every transition checks lock unchanged (28) and capacity not decreased (17); data parse errors (1 / 2) come first. An Active output always takes the pledge path, so the Active-target branch of check_status_justified (also 10) is unreachable

notes.zh: pledge 归属：pledge cell 的 lock code_hash = args[32..64] 且 lock args[0..32] = 本 campaign 的 type hash。归属 pledge 的 lock args 必须 ≥ 72 字节且 deadline 与 campaign 相同（否则 26），否则其金额不计入也不放行。pledge data 里的 campaign_id 仅作信息
notes.en: A pledge belongs to the campaign when its lock code_hash = args[32..64] and lock args[0..32] = this campaign's type hash. A belonging pledge must have lock args ≥ 72 bytes and the campaign's deadline (else 26). pledge data's campaign_id is informational only

notes.zh: 消耗的 pledge 不设最低金额，但同样要求归属、deadline（26）与 capacity（22）；新建 pledge 的金额 ≥ 100 CKB（23）
notes.en: Consumed pledges have no minimum amount but still need the matching deadline (26) and enough capacity (22); created pledges need amount ≥ 100 CKB (23)

notes.zh: 截止规则：since 为 0 视为绝对区块 0（而非非法编码），因此在 1 → 2 报 10、在 2 → 0 报 13；destruction 先检查创建者出资（24），再检查 since（13）
notes.en: Since rule: since = 0 is absolute block 0, not an invalid encoding, so it fails with 10 in 1 → 2 and 13 in 2 → 0; destruction checks creator payout (24) before since (13)

notes.zh: 谁能花费 campaign cell（以及截止前能否结算）由 campaign-lock 决定，本页不覆盖（见 crowdcell_campaign_lock 卡片）；pledge cell 自身的 type 规则见 CrowdCell 的 pledge 类型脚本（未收录）
notes.en: Who may spend the campaign cell (and whether it can finalize before the deadline) is decided by campaign-lock, not covered here (see the crowdcell_campaign_lock card); pledge cells' own type rules live in CrowdCell's pledge type script (not included)

notes.zh: 非本合约规则：README 的 ~180 天按 8 秒/块估算
notes.en: Not a contract rule: the README's ~180 days assumes 8 s blocks

notes.zh: CrowdCell 自述为测试网预览，未经独立审计
notes.en: CrowdCell describes itself as a testnet preview; not independently audited
